description: This PHP file defines the 'updatePortal' class used for managing portal user updates and email communications in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for updating user details based on portal access and sending emails via configured templates.

classes.name: updatePortal
classes.description: Class responsible for updating portal user information and sending notification emails in the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates the user information for a contact when portal access is provided, including sending a templated email.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Constructs and sends an email message using specified content and email settings, and records the email in the CRM.
